prompt_en:
Goal: Create a bold illustrated travel poster for New York City with an anime street-fashion heroine towering over a rainy nighttime Manhattan street, mixing photoreal urban landmarks with comic sticker doodles and punchy typography.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, high-resolution, full-bleed. Dark blue dusk sky fading into warm city lights and wet reflective pavement. Energetic youth-culture advertising composition.

Layout: Left third is dominated by a stacked headline in huge condensed uppercase block letters. Center background shows the Empire State Building lit up, with Manhattan skyscrapers behind it. Right half features a full-body anime girl standing in an exaggerated low-angle heroic pose, one foot very large in the foreground. Bottom and side areas are filled with sticker-like NYC icons and doodles.

Main text: Large headline at upper left reads exactly: “YOUR NEW YORK ADVENTURE STARTS HERE”. Use white for “YOUR,” “ADVENTURE,” and “HERE,” yellow for “NEW YORK,” and hot pink for “STARTS.” Below it, handwritten script reads exactly: “Ride the subway. Hit the streets. Taste the city.” with “subway” in cyan and “city” in hot pink. Add small sticker text blocks reading exactly: “NYC IT HITS DIFFERENT,” “NYC ♥ ALL DAY. EVERY DAY. LIVE IT. LOVE IT.,” and “BIG DREAMS BIGGER CITY.” Add a round subway badge near the Empire State Building reading “NEW YORK CITY” around the rim, a large “7” in the center, and “SUBWAY” underneath.

Character details: The main character is one young anime woman, cheerful and confident, with bright cyan-blue hair with magenta-pink tips, short bob haircut, big expressive eyes, and a small smile. She waves with her raised right hand and holds a steaming hot dog in her left hand. Outfit: oversized yellow-and-black bomber jacket with patches and graffiti marks, black cropped top, black baggy cargo pants with zipper details and pink “Brooklyn” graffiti on one leg, layered necklaces, earrings, rings, and chunky cream high-top sneakers with pink heart and black accents. Jacket includes visible pink “NYC” lettering and yellow graphic patches.

Counted visual elements: Include exactly 1 main anime girl, 1 Empire State Building, 1 steaming hot dog in her hand, 1 oversized foreground hot dog sticker at bottom left, 1 yellow taxi sticker riding a blue wave, 1 small pizza-slice sticker near the upper right, 1 large pizza-slice sticker on the right, 1 Chrysler Building doodle, 1 bearded pigeon with sunglasses and a cap at bottom right, 1 pink heart doodle above the girl, 1 yellow star near the left center, 2 pink star stickers, and 1 pink heart sticker near the “NYC it hits different” label.

Visual style: Hybrid anime illustration and gritty urban poster design; saturated cyan, yellow, hot pink, black, and cream palette; thick black ink outlines; halftone texture; hand-drawn sticker borders; subtle film grain; splattered ink and small bird silhouettes. City background should feel cinematic and semi-realistic, while the character and stickers are crisp comic/anime art.

Atmosphere: Adventurous, playful, iconic, and aspirational, like a modern NYC tourism poster for young travelers. Wet streets reflect taxi lights and skyline glow. Add steam from the hot dog and tiny radiating lines around the heart doodle.

Constraints: Keep all visible text legible and spelled correctly. Do not add logos, watermarks, QR codes, or extra paragraphs of text. Preserve the exact poster hierarchy: headline on left, character on right, Empire State Building centered behind, sticker collage around the bottom and sides.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a wide brand identity and advertising creative overview for a minimalist Nordic skincare brand named FJÄLL, showing a complete campaign system on a clean white studio background.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 presentation board with a lot of negative space, soft warm off-white background, centered composition. Use muted Scandinavian colors: stone gray, cream, beige, sage green, charcoal blue-gray, and natural skin tones. Lighting is soft, diffused, premium, and editorial.

Layout: Arrange exactly 11 discrete tiles in a refined grid. Top row contains 3 larger brand assets: 1) a minimal circular mountain-line logo with the word FJÄLL and small subtext, 2) an alternate logo with a small abstract mountain/stone icon above the word FJÄLL and the tagline “NORDIC SKINCARE”, 3) a square product still-life photo of one dark gray skincare tube standing upright on a pale stone surface with a rock prop. Bottom row contains exactly 8 campaign mockups, evenly spaced and aligned: 1) square lifestyle product photo with hands holding the tube beside a cream product information card, 2) square close-up of a gray clay/mineral cream smear on stone with tiny text “MINERAL TEXTURE”, 3) vertical application tutorial tile showing cream being applied to fingers with a simple header, 4) vertical dew/balm hand-care tile showing cream rubbed onto the back of a hand, 5) square hero ingredient tile with the tube standing among stones, leaves, and three circular ingredient callouts, 6) vertical social media video interface mockup with a hand holding the product, visible play/engagement UI icons along the side and bottom, 7) vertical ad poster with the product tube, botanical sprigs, rock props, and headline text near the bottom, 8) tall mobile website or landing-page mockup with a clean navigation bar, product detail blocks, and an application photo.

Subject details: The product is a single squeeze tube labeled FJÄLL, matte dark blue-gray packaging, white minimalist typography, small circular emblem, premium cosmetic proportions. The skincare texture is thick, mineral, clay-like, pale gray-beige. Hands should look natural, softly lit, and elegant. Props include smooth stones, mineral rocks, small green leaves, neutral linen or plaster surfaces, and shallow shadows.

Text content: Include readable brand text “FJÄLL” on logos and packaging, “NORDIC SKINCARE” as a tagline, and campaign/product text suggesting Midnight Solstice, Performance in every touch., mineral texture, application, dew-bomb, and ingredient callouts. Keep small body copy mostly decorative but plausible, clean, and aligned.

Visual style: Luxury skincare art direction, minimal Swiss editorial layout, soft product photography, airy whitespace, muted natural palette, understated typography, commercial creative portfolio look. Make the entire board appear like a polished generated ad-material batch preview rather than a single ad.

Constraints: Use exactly 11 visible tiles total, exactly 3 on the top row and exactly 8 on the bottom row. Do not add extra products beyond the one tube design. Avoid bright colors, clutter, heavy shadows, glossy plastic, cartoon style, or watermarks.\

title: Aji Fry 动漫烹饪分镜
author: @オズ
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,草图 / 线稿,漫画 / 图像小说,美食 / 饮品
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a very rough pencil storyboard sheet for a 15-second Japanese 2D anime cooking short about golden aji fry, showing the full cooking process from raw fish to plated fried cutlet.

Canvas: Ultra-wide 21:9 horizontal aspect ratio, black-and-white pencil sketch on white paper, divided into exactly 12 rectangular panels in a 3-row by 4-column grid. Use thin black panel borders, hand-drawn construction lines, loose animation-layout perspective, energetic hatching, and no color.

Visual style: Japanese anime storyboard / rough keyframe layout, realistic kitchen props, cinematic close-ups, dynamic hands-in-frame action, visible sketch strokes, light shading, steam, bubbles, splashes, crumbs, and motion lines. Keep everything monochrome graphite, like a production storyboard before cleanup.

Panel count and contents: Include exactly 12 discrete storyboard panels, read left to right, top to bottom. Panel 1: kitchen prep counter in perspective with three opened horse mackerel fillets on a cutting board, a hand sprinkling seasoning from above, sink and small bottles in the background. Panel 2: top-down close-up of both hands pressing or flattening the opened fish fillets on a tray, emphasizing preparation before breading. Panel 3: hand dropping or coating a fish fillet in a shallow tray of flour or breadcrumbs, powder and crumbs flying upward. Panel 4: chopsticks lifting a breaded fish fillet in a shallow egg or wet batter tray, another tray nearby, liquid ripples around it. Panel 5: close-up of hands burying and pressing the fish into a mound of coarse panko breadcrumbs in a rectangular tray. Panel 6: large pot of hot oil on a gas stove, flames visible underneath, oil surface shimmering, kitchen shelves and bottles behind. Panel 7: long cooking chopsticks lowering a breaded fish fillet into the bubbling oil, the pot handles visible, intense frying action beginning. Panel 8: extreme close-up of the frying surface packed with bubbles and crispy crumb texture around the fish. Panel 9: chopsticks lifting the fully fried crispy fish from the pot, oil dripping back down, strong steam and bubbling oil. Panel 10: the fried fish resting on a wire rack over a tray, chopsticks releasing it, oil drips beneath the rack. Panel 11: a knife cutting through the fried aji fry on a cutting board, revealing the soft white fish interior under the crunchy crust, steam rising. Panel 12: final plated dish with two crispy aji fry pieces on a round plate, shredded cabbage, a lemon wedge, steam, and a stream of dark sauce pouring from above onto the cutlet.

Text content: Do not add captions, speech bubbles, numbers, logos, or watermarks; the storyboard should be purely visual.

Constraints: Maintain a consistent kitchen setting and continuous cooking sequence. Make the panels feel like rough pre-production art for 15-second Japanese 2D animation. Use loose graphite pencil storyboard lines with high food texture detail. Emphasize the appetizing transformation into a crispy golden aji fry plate with cabbage, lemon, and sauce, even though the image remains black and white.\

Canvas: 16:9 landscape frame, dark teal and black digital arena viewed from a high three-quarter camera angle. The background is a vast circular cyber grid made of concentric rings, circuit-board patterns, holographic city blocks, and vertical equalizer-like teal light bars around the horizon.

Main subject: At the center, an anime-style female cyber angel named Xione Origin with long flowing silver-white hair, pale skin, sharp futuristic armor, and translucent mechanical wing blades. She is mid-flight in a dynamic pose, wielding glowing energy blades and controlling four small white blade drones orbiting her. Her color palette is black, gunmetal, white, and neon cyan, with bright teal thruster trails and gold spark impacts.

Action composition: Show exactly 5 hostile mecha enemies: 1 large armored enemy in the upper right being struck by a bright explosion, 1 large bulky enemy in the lower left, 1 medium enemy on the right edge, 1 medium enemy lower right, and 1 smaller enemy near the mid-right. Add red targeting lines, red warning labels, triangular danger icons, and laser beams pointing toward the player. The central attack forms a huge sweeping cyan crescent slash and circular arc around the heroine, while exactly 4 white blade drones leave golden trails: one upper left, one left-middle, one bottom center, and one lower right. Include particle sparks, lens flares, motion blur, and curved light ribbons to emphasize speed.

HUD and text elements: Add a complete game interface overlay with crisp futuristic typography. Top left: character portrait, label “XIONE ORIGIN”, health “4200 / 4200”, “100%”, and “CODE SYNC — OK”. Left center: “COMBO” with large number 256 and small “EXCELLENT”. Top right: “TIME” with 04:37, “SCORE” with 238,650, and “MULTIPLIER x4.8”. Right center: “ENEMY 12” and “+120”. Bottom right: circular radar/minimap with teal cone indicator and red enemy dots. Bottom left: exactly 4 ability icons labeled “QUANTUM EDGE”, “PHOTON CHARGE”, “PHASE BREAK”, and “ORIGIN DRIVE”, each with small keyboard prompts such as Z, X, C, and SPACE.

Visual style: High-detail anime sci-fi illustration blended with AAA game UI concept art, dark cinematic lighting, neon cyan accents, red enemy warnings, golden impact sparks, clean sharp linework, dense holographic details, ultra-wide battlefield readability, dramatic depth, no borders, no watermark.

Constraints: Keep all visible text in English, make the interface look like an actual action-game screenshot, preserve the exact counts of 5 enemies, 4 blade drones, and 4 ability icons, and avoid adding extra characters or extra UI panels beyond the described HUD.\

categories: 游戏素材,3D 渲染,角色
prompt_en:
- Thin, simple arms and legs attached directly to the sphere
- Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed

- The body must look identical across all outputs
- This is the same reused 3D model every time

If the character looks humanoid instead of spherical, it is incorrect.

---

IDENTITY MAPPING:

Map the provided character onto this spherical body:

- Place facial features directly on the sphere
- Preserve:
- eye shape, size, spacing, expression
- eyebrows and attitude
- simple mouth if needed

- Add key identity elements:
- hair (wrapped around the sphere)
- hat (must sit naturally on top of the sphere)
- accessories (glasses, etc.)
- colors and patterns

- The character must be recognizable at a glance

- This is NOT a redesign:
→ it should look like the same character forced into this body

---

CLOTHING MAPPING (CRITICAL):

- The body MUST remain a perfect sphere
- Clothing must NOT change the body shape

- Clothes are applied as a surface layer on the sphere
- Think: painted, printed, or lightly embossed onto the sphere

---

STYLE:

- Smooth matte plastic material
- Clean, minimal geometry
- Toy-like Pixar / vinyl figure style
- Soft reflections

---

SCENE:

A cozy child’s bedroom:
- Wooden floor
- Bed with striped blanket
- Children’s drawings on the wall
- Warm ambient lighting
- Soft depth of field

---

RENDER:

- High-quality 3D render (Blender / Octane style)
- Cinematic lighting
- Global illumination
- 50mm lens
- Sharp focus on character
- Soft shadows
- 4K resolution

---

FINAL INTENT:

The result should look like a meme:
the exact same spherical Mike Wazowski-style body every time,
with different characters awkwardly and humorously mapped onto it.

Everything must conform to the spherical body.
Nothing can override the sphere.\

1. A girl sitting on a wooden swing, wearing a sage green short-sleeve floral dress, cream socks, tan sandals, holding both swing ropes; a small wicker basket bag with a cute animal face hangs beside her. Her face is obscured by a soft beige square blur.
2. A standing girl in a lavender puff-sleeve blouse and long ivory suspender skirt, holding a small bouquet of purple lavender flowers in one hand and a wicker basket with animal face decoration in the other. Her face is obscured by a soft beige square blur.
3. A walking girl in blue denim overalls over a pale yellow shirt, holding a bubble wand near her mouth with several tiny translucent bubbles floating beside her; she carries a cream shoulder bag with a cute animal face patch.
4. A girl walking while eating an ice cream cone, wearing a peach gingham puff-sleeve blouse and long ivory lace skirt; she carries a wicker basket decorated with white flowers.

title: 故事板重新渲染工作流程 UI
author: @FINN MCKENTY
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,应用 / 网页设计,动漫 / 漫画,3D 渲染,角色
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dark node-based workflow screenshot showing a side-by-side comparison between a gray 3D animation storyboard and a re-rendered 90s anime-style storyboard, as if inside a visual AI/compositing tool.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 screen capture on a nearly black dotted grid workspace. Add thin teal curved connector lines between nodes, with small circular input/output ports on the node edges.

Layout: Place exactly 2 tall rounded-rectangle nodes side by side. Both nodes are titled “Painter” at the top left with a small brush/pen icon, and a three-dot menu at the top right. The left node shows the grayscale source storyboard; the right node shows the stylized output storyboard. Each node contains exactly 4 stacked widescreen storyboard frames separated by thick black dividers, followed by a compact painter control panel at the bottom.

Left node storyboard frames: Render all 4 frames as monochrome gray 3D viewport/cinematic previz images with low-saturation clay materials and simple urban geometry. Frame 1: a generic male mannequin walks down a city sidewalk with storefronts, a hydrant, street pole, and road markings. Frame 2: the mannequin raises one leg toward a stone building wall as if beginning to climb. Frame 3: the mannequin is partially up the wall, body leaning back, legs pressed against the facade. Frame 4: rear view of the mannequin walking upward along a vertical building facade, with windows and rooftop perspective visible.

Right node storyboard frames: Recreate the same 4 actions and camera angles, but as detailed 1990s hand-painted anime cel animation. Use a young adult male character with green jacket, blue jeans, and brown shoes, brown hair, and realistic anime proportions. Frame 1: he walks along a sunny city sidewalk past storefronts, a red fire hydrant, streetlight, and road marking “633”. Frame 2: he lifts his foot onto a stone wall beside a glass storefront. Frame 3: he climbs higher on the building facade, with street, hydrant, fire escape, and shop signs in the background. Frame 4: rear view as he walks vertically up the pale building wall, windows receding below him and rooftops visible ahead.

Painter controls: At the bottom of each node show exactly 3 tool icons: a highlighted yellow brush icon, an eraser icon, and a grid/hash icon. Include a small “Reset” label on the right. Under the icons show exactly 3 labeled controls: Color with a white swatch and hex text “FFFFFF” plus “100%”; Size with a slider, left node value “30” and right node value “60”; Hardness with a slider and “100%”.

Visual style: Crisp UI mockup, dark charcoal panels, rounded corners, subtle shadows, muted teal connector accents, precise alignment. The left storyboard should look like a gray 3D render, while the right storyboard should look like a polished anime repaint with blue-gray shadows, ink outlines, hand-painted backgrounds, and cinematic framing.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 nodes, exactly 4 storyboard frames per node, and exactly 3 controls per node. Keep all visible UI text in English. Do not add extra panels, logos, watermarks, or explanatory captions outside the node interface.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cute Japanese 5-panel slice-of-life manga page about a lazy day off for a blonde chibi girl, in a warm hand-drawn comic style.

Canvas: Vertical comic page, 4:5 aspect ratio, thick black outer border, cream paper texture, bold black gutters. Use exactly 5 panels: two equal panels across the top row, one wide horizontal panel across the middle row, and two equal panels across the bottom row.

Main character: A short chibi-style blonde girl with straight bob-length hair, blunt bangs, long side locks, sleepy half-lidded blue eyes, small mouth, light blush, wearing an oversized dark burgundy T-shirt, dark pants, and socks. She appears relaxed, smug, or sleepy depending on the panel.

Panel layout and contents:
1. Top-left panel: The girl sits at a wooden table holding a stemmed glass of red wine. A dark green wine bottle with a cream label and tiny crown icon stands on the table to her left. Add a small pink heart near the glass. Her expression is tipsy and content. Use a white thought/speech bubble on the left with vertical Japanese text: ワインを飲んでのんびり〜.
2. Top-right panel: The girl sits on a wooden chair playing a shamisen or erhu-like Japanese string instrument, holding the bow/stick across the strings. Include a black music stand with sheet music in front, a hanging wall scroll behind her, a small bookshelf with books and a potted plant at the right. Add two small sound-effect texts near the instrument: 「スーッ」 and 「スーッ」. Add a tall white speech bubble on the right with vertical Japanese text: 休みの日は二胡を弾いて.
3. Middle wide panel: The girl naps on a green couch under a beige blanket, head on a yellow pillow, eyes closed with a peaceful blush. At left are a potted leafy houseplant and a window with green curtains, blue sky, a white cloud, and greenery outside. Add sleepy floating text above her: 「ZZZZ…」. Add a white speech bubble on the right with vertical Japanese text: 昼寝をたっぷりと….
4. Bottom-left panel: Close-up dynamic gaming shot of the girl holding a black-and-red game controller with both hands. Her eyes glow with flame shapes, mouth open in excitement. Background has tan speed lines. Add large red comic sound-effect text at top: 「ピコーン!!」. Add a vertical white speech bubble on the left with Japanese text: よっしゃー!.
5. Bottom-right panel: The girl sits on the floor playing a handheld game controller, looking relaxed and satisfied. Include a TV on a low stand at left, a Nintendo Switch-like console with red and blue controllers on a shelf at right, books/game cases on shelves, a low table with a red drink cup and straw plus a blue game case. Add a small music-note bubble above her and a white thought bubble on the right with vertical Japanese text: 起きたらゲーム最高〜.

Visual style: Cute chibi manga illustration, thick expressive black outlines, warm beige indoor backgrounds, soft watercolor-like fills, simple cel shading, cozy casual atmosphere, slightly imperfect hand-drawn linework, readable vertical Japanese lettering in white speech bubbles, no photorealism.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 panels and exactly these main repeated settings: wine drinking, instrument practice, couch nap, intense controller close-up, relaxed gaming corner. Do not add extra panels, extra characters, logos, watermarks, or English text inside the comic.\

prompt_en:
Ultra-realistic portrait of a beautiful Korean woman leaning far back in a wooden classroom chair, both arms stretched wide open above her head in a full, uninhibited stretch — head tilted back, eyes closed, expression pure physical release and quiet euphoria. The posture of someone who has just finished something difficult. Camera positioned at eye level directly in front, capturing the full arc of the stretch.
Wearing a fitted white athletic crop top with subtle ribbing, high-waisted dark charcoal cargo-style wide-leg joggers and oversized white athletic jacket draped open — sleeves pushed to the elbows. White low-top sneakers. Silver hoop earrings. Long dark brown hair loose, cascading back and away from her face with the stretch. A graded exam paper face-down on the desk in front of her — score just barely visible.
Golden late afternoon light floods over her from the window — with arms stretched wide, her silhouette opens dramatically against the amber-lit classroom, casting a bold long shadow behind her chair. The white jacket catches bright highlights, the cargo pants deep in warm shadow. Dust motes swirling gently in the disturbed air around her.
35mm analog film grain, Kodak Portra 400 — crisp white athletic wear glowing in Portra's warmth, charcoal joggers beautifully shadowed. Hyper-realistic athletic fabric and hair motion texture. Shallow depth of field. Mood: unbounded relief, young freedom, cinematic moment of release — joyful without performance.\
